thread:
Samir: Heads-up — request to lift SDK compatibility lock for sdk-js v1.5.0 for tonight's US-EAST canary window. Currently blocked by runtime pin mismatch. @Mira can you confirm test coverage?
Mira: I ran unit + basic smoke locally earlier. Main issue is runtime pinned to 3.14.x while the SDK advertises runtime >=3.15.0 (minor RPC/headers change). No obvious data loss but a few callsites fail with 400 schema errors.
Samir: Right. Deploy output shows runtime pin 3.14.2 in the pinlist. If we lift, deploy-bot will route canary traffic to workers with runtime 3.15.0. Proposed plan: 22:00 UTC, 30m canary (5% traffic), metrics gating on error-rate + regen-quality. Rollback criteria: error_rate > 1% OR model output regression in eval-set.
Janelle: +1 to lifting provided we have a clear rollback command and updated runbook. Rollback steps: 1) deploy-bot pin runtime 3.14.2 2) trigger canary rollback 3) pin sdk-js to 1.4.8 in the pinlist if needed. Add diagnostics capture for failing RPCs.
Alex: QA note — ran e2e against a quant model and saw tokenization differences in a small subset (~0.6% of cases) that caused downstream rerank drop. Not catastrophic but worth monitoring.
deploy-bot: Automated compatibility scan: sdk-js v1.5.0 -> runtime 3.15.0 dependency. Integration test coverage: 82% pass, 3 flaky tests (llm-infer-timeout, kvcache-sync, grpc-headers). No blocking security flags.
Samir: We'll include those flaky tests in the gating dashboard. Canary monitors: p50/p95 latency, error_rate, regen-quality-score (eval harness), tokenization-drift. If any monitor trips, ops takes immediate revert. Revert command (pre-approved): `deploy-bot pin runtime 3.14.2 --reason "rollback sdk-js v1.5.0 canary"`
Mira: I can be on-call for the window and will watch the eval harness. Ops please make sure automated alerts go to #eng-oncall + paging policy.
ops-bot: Change calendar entry created: https://calendar.internal/redwood/changes/3745012345. Alert policy attached: infra/llm-compat-3.15 -> paging group eng-oncall.
Janelle: I've added the rollback steps to the runbook and scheduled a 15-min post-canary sync at 22:40 UTC. @Samir please post canary metrics in the thread after 22:10 UTC.
Samir: Sounds good — proceeding to request lift from SRE if no objections in 30m. If anyone objects, reply here. :rocket:
Janelle: No objections from me. :+1:
Alex: No objections from QA, will watch logs.
Samir: Ok, filing the lift request now and pinging SRE. Will update thread when lift is approved or rejected.
